oldFiles.note: Round 17 (R282). The hand of each old prototype file of the Native models of 2022 against the Prototypes_2024 files, by the rules both generations follow on one CAD reference: the cluster side for a cluster unit, the block mirror flag of the Building Footprint for a villa. same lists the codes whose 2024 file takes the same mirror on that reference, so it is drawn the same hand, opposite those drawn the other hand. A code in neither list has no common reference

levelProfiles.note: Round 17 (R277). The level rule of each generation of past site models, by name. default names the profile of every new build, parsons2024Rev6, since Rev 6 prevails (Bader, Q050, Round ADDIN). native2022 stays for reference and is used only when a build names it. job is the group of majority.groups in config/project.json whose overrides a build of that profile may apply (R280).

keyRules.note: Round ADDIN 3a (R331 to R335). The rules the 7 Parsons answer keys follow, measured by python/majority.py on round_addin past_all.csv: the candidate coded, its share over the Parsons plots it covers and per key, strong at majority.strongShare, the share of the Native keys beside it (native, this run, nativeRound17, the table of Round 17 where it had one) and the plots it misses, each an override of source parsons in config/overrides. The values are lengths, angles and names, never a coordinate or a level.
